_____________________  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE PUSHPENDRA SINGH BHATI Order 13/09/2017 1.

The petitioner-State of Rajasthan has preferred this misc. petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
against the order dated 4.06.2016 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Pali in the criminal revision No.727/2013(6/2011) for the offence under Section 7/16 for Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, whereby she maintained the order dated 8.10.2013 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sumerpur whereby she discharging the accused from the offence under Section 7/16 for Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

2. The accused respondents were discharged under Sections 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act on 8.10.2013 and the revision petition was preferred and the same was also dismissed on 4.06.2016.

State vs Bhanwar Lal & Ors on 13 September, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85425674/
1 3.

The some and substance of both the orders below is that the Section 32(i) in the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act which reads as follows:
"Explanation(vi)--"Wholesale package" means a package containing:--
(a) a number of retail packages, where such first mentioned packages are intended for sale, distribution or delivery to an intermediary and are not intended for sale direct to any consumer, or (b) a commodity of food sold to an intermediary in bulk to enable such intermediary to sell, distribute or deliver such commodity of food to the consumer in smaller quantities."
4.
The language of Section 32(e) in the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is expunged and the petitioner has clearly false under the definition of wholesale package of under Section 32(e).
5. This Court has perused both the orders passed by the learned court below.
The orders are in accordance with law and the accused cannot be proceeded against the non existing law and his prosecution is invalid.
Hence, no interference is called for and the misc. petition is dismissed.

(DR. PUSHPENDRA SINGH BHATI)J. Ck State vs Bhanwar Lal & Ors on 13 September, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85425674/
